perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Coils
perks.desc:
Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.desc:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery
perks.desc:
Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.desc:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.desc:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine. 

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.desc: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.desc: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.
